title: Under Eye Fat Bag Removal
subtitle: Lower Blepharoplasty
description: Say goodbye to tired-looking eyes. Under eye fat bag removal (often part of a lower blepharoplasty) is a highly effective surgical procedure designed to eliminate puffiness, deep bags, and dark shadows under the eyes. By carefully removing or repositioning excess fat, this procedure restores a smooth, youthful, and well-rested appearance.

bullets.title: Eliminates Puffiness:
bullets.text: Permanently removes stubborn fat deposits under the eyes that don't respond to sleep or skincare.

bullets.title: Refreshed Appearance:
bullets.text: Erases the "tired" look by creating a smooth transition from the lower eyelid to the cheek.

bullets.title: Hidden Incisions:
bullets.text: Incisions are often made inside the lower eyelid (transconjunctival), leaving no visible external scarring.

bullets.title: Long-Lasting Results:
bullets.text: Provides a permanent solution to under-eye bags with a high satisfaction rate and natural-looking outcome.

title: Otoplasty
subtitle: Telephone Ear Deformity
description: Otoplasty is a transformative surgical procedure designed to correct prominent or disproportionate ears. Specifically addressing the "telephone ear" deformity—where the middle of the ear is pinned back while the top and bottom poles protrude—this procedure expertly reshapes the cartilage to achieve a naturally balanced, harmonious appearance.

bullets.title: Restores Balance:
bullets.text: Harmonizes protruding ears by pinning them closer to the head, significantly improving overall facial symmetry.

bullets.title: Telephone Ear Correction:
bullets.text: Expertly addresses the unique challenge of adjusting the ear's upper and lower poles to ensure a natural contour.

bullets.title: Customized Cartilage Reshaping:
bullets.text: Tailored surgical techniques are used to reshape, fold, and secure the ear cartilage for lasting results.

bullets.title: Hidden Scars:
bullets.text: Incisions are meticulously placed in the natural crease behind the ear, keeping any scarring completely concealed.

title: Minimally Invasive
description: The minimally invasive Thread Lift is a revolutionary procedure designed to instantly elevate and contour sagging skin. Using biocompatible, dissolvable threads, this treatment physically lifts the face while simultaneously stimulating your body’s natural collagen production for long-lasting, beautifully natural results.

bullets.title: Instant Lift:
bullets.text: Provides an immediate, noticeable lifting effect for the mid-face, jawline, and neck.

bullets.title: Collagen Stimulation:
bullets.text: As the threads safely dissolve over time, they trigger collagen synthesis, dramatically improving skin texture and firmness.

bullets.title: Minimally Invasive:
bullets.text: A fantastic alternative to a traditional surgical facelift, requiring no large incisions or general anesthesia.

bullets.title: Minimal Downtime:
bullets.text: Patients can typically resume their normal daily activities much faster than with extensive surgical procedures.

title: Ptosis Correction
subtitle: Eyelid Lifting Surgery
description: Ptosis correction is a highly specialized surgical procedure that lifts drooping upper eyelids caused by weakened muscles. By tightening the levator muscle, this procedure not only restores a wide, awake, and refreshed appearance, but it can also significantly improve obstructed upper field vision.

bullets.title: Awakens Your Look:
bullets.text: Eliminates the heavy, tired, or "sleepy" appearance caused by sagging eyelids, giving you a bright and refreshed look.

bullets.title: Restores Vision:
bullets.text: Effectively lifts eyelids that may be drooping far enough to obstruct your upper field of vision, restoring full and clear eyesight.

bullets.title: Symmetrical Results:
bullets.text: Expert surgical precision balances asymmetrical eyelids, ensuring both eyes look beautifully even and harmonious.

bullets.title: Hidden Incisions:
bullets.text: The very fine incisions are typically hidden precisely within the natural crease of the upper eyelid, resulting in virtually undetectable scars once healed.

title: Mole Removal
subtitle: Skin Refinement
description: Achieve a flawless, uninterrupted complexion with our expert mole removal procedures. Whether for cosmetic refinement or medical peace of mind, we use advanced excision techniques designed to remove unwanted moles completely while ensuring the most minimal, virtually invisible scarring.

bullets.title: Aesthetic Precision:
bullets.text: Carefully and entirely removes distracting or unwanted moles to restore a smooth skin surface.

bullets.title: Minimal Scarring:
bullets.text: Utilizes fine surgical techniques, such as shave biopsies or precise excisions, to leave the smallest possible mark.

bullets.title: Quick & Comfortable:
bullets.text: A straightforward outpatient procedure performed safely under local anesthesia, taking only minutes per mole.

bullets.title: Peace of Mind:
bullets.text: Extracted tissue can be sent for professional pathological screening to verify your dermatological health and safety.

title: Hair Transplant
subtitle: FUE / FUT Procedures
description: Restore a full, natural head of hair and regain your confidence with advanced hair transplant surgery. Utilizing state-of-the-art techniques, healthy hair follicles are carefully extracted and meticulously implanted into thinning or balding areas, ensuring natural growth and permanent results.

bullets.title: Natural Hairline Design:
bullets.text: Meticulously re-creates an age-appropriate, beautifully contoured hairline tailored precisely to your facial proportions.

bullets.title: Permanent Results:
bullets.text: Uses your own genetically resistant hair follicles (typically from the back of the head) for permanent, lasting growth.

bullets.title: Advanced Techniques:
bullets.text: Utilizes cutting-edge FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction) or FUT methods to maximize graft survival while minimizing scarring.

bullets.title: Boosts Confidence:
bullets.text: Effectively reverses the visible signs of hair thinning or baldness, giving you a dense, thick head of hair and renewed self-assurance.

title: Rhinoplasty
subtitle: Nose Reshaping
description: Rhinoplasty is a highly personalized surgical procedure designed to enhance the natural harmony of your face. By expertly refining the shape, size, or structural contours of the nose, this surgery can dramatically boost self-confidence while also addressing functional issues for optimal breathing.

bullets.title: Facial Harmony:
bullets.text: Balances your overall facial proportions by refining the structure and aesthetic contour of the nose.

bullets.title: Corrects Imperfections:
bullets.text: Effectively smooths out prominent dorsal humps, refines bulbous nasal tips, and straightens crooked profiles.

bullets.title: Improves Breathing:
bullets.text: Functional rhinoplasty (often combined with a septoplasty) corrects structural abnormalities to restore clear, effortless airflow.

bullets.title: Customized Approach:
bullets.text: Every procedure is meticulously tailored to respect your unique ethnic features and natural aesthetic goals.

title: Face Lift
subtitle: Deep Plane Face Lift
description: Turn back the clock with a transformative surgical face lift. Specializing in the advanced Deep Plane technique, this procedure goes beyond just tightening the skin. By repositioning the deeper muscle layers, it delivers a profoundly natural, long-lasting rejuvenation that never looks "pulled" or tight.

bullets.title: Comprehensive Rejuvenation:
bullets.text: Dramatically reduces sagging skin, deep nasolabial folds, and prominent jowls for a smooth, youthful contour.

bullets.title: Deep Plane Technique:
bullets.text: Lifts and repositions the underlying structural tissues (SMAS layer), ensuring results are remarkably natural and durable.

bullets.title: Restores Volume:
bullets.text: Beautifully elevates descended facial fat pads back to their original, youthful positions high on the cheekbones.

bullets.title: Defines the Jawline:
bullets.text: Expertly tightens the neck and lower face to recreate a sharp, elegant, and refined jawline profile.

title: Jaw Angle Implants
subtitle: Facial Contouring
description: Achieve a strong, beautifully chiseled jawline with custom facial implants. Specifically designed to enhance the mandibular angles, this surgical procedure creates a highly defined lower face, restoring aesthetic balance and adding striking, permanent structure to your profile.

bullets.title: Defined Jawline:
bullets.text: Instantly enhances and widens the lower face, providing the sharp, structured jawline you desire.

bullets.title: Facial Harmony:
bullets.text: Expertly corrects weak or asymmetrical jaw angles to restore perfect proportion to the lower third of the face.

bullets.title: Permanent Contouring:
bullets.text: Unlike temporary dermal fillers, precision-crafted silicone implants offer a permanent, stable structural enhancement.

bullets.title: Hidden Incisions:
bullets.text: The procedure is typically performed entirely through small incisions inside the mouth, leaving absolutely no external scarring.

title: Fat Augmentation
subtitle: Macro, Micro & Nano Fat
description: Restore youthful volume and profoundly improve skin quality using your body's own natural fat. Through advanced purification, we utilize Macro fat for deep structural support, Micro fat for delicate contouring, and Nano fat to deliver a powerful boost of regenerative stem cells directly to the skin.

bullets.title: Natural Volume:
bullets.text: Uses your body's own purified fat cells to safely restore lost facial volume, ensuring completely natural-looking and feeling results.

bullets.title: Versatile Application:
bullets.text: Beautifully tailored: Macro fat restores deep volume, Micro fat refines contours, and Nano fat addresses fine lines.

bullets.title: Stem Cell Benefits:
bullets.text: The transferred fat is rich in natural stem cells that continuously rejuvenate the overlying skin, giving it a healthy, radiant glow.

bullets.title: Long-Lasting:
bullets.text: Because it utilizes your living tissue, a significant portion of the transferred fat becomes a permanent, beautiful part of your facial structure.

title: Blepharoplasty
subtitle: with Fat Bag Removal
description: Awaken your eyes and erase the appearance of exhaustion. This comprehensive eyelid surgery meticulously removes excess, drooping skin from the upper and lower lids while simultaneously eliminating or repositioning bulging under-eye fat bags to restore a bright, entirely refreshed look.

bullets.title: Comprehensive Rejuvenation:
bullets.text: Expertly removes heavy, sagging skin from both the upper and lower eyelids for a profoundly rested appearance.

bullets.title: Eliminates Eye Bags:
bullets.text: Skillfully targets and removes prominent under-eye fat pads to completely erase the look of chronic fatigue.

bullets.title: Smoothes Contours:
bullets.text: Restores a seamless, youthful transition between the lower eyelid and the upper cheek, eliminating deep hollows.

bullets.title: Virtually Invisible Scars:
bullets.text: Incisions are meticulously hidden within the natural creases of the upper eyelids and just below the lower lash line.

title: Platysmaplasty
subtitle: Surgical Neck Lift
description: Reclaim a sleek, youthful neckline with an advanced platysmaplasty. This powerful surgical procedure directly tightens the underlying neck muscles (platysma) and removes excess, sagging skin, effectively eliminating the appearance of a "turkey neck" and prominent vertical bands.

bullets.title: Defines the Neckline:
bullets.text: Expertly tightens the underlying platysma muscles to eliminate prominent vertical banding and severe sagging.

bullets.title: Restores Youthful Contours:
bullets.text: Removes excess skin and fat from under the chin to recreate a beautifully sharp and elegant jawline profile.

bullets.title: Long-Lasting Results:
bullets.text: Unlike non-surgical alternatives, this surgical intervention provides profound, structural, and highly durable rejuvenation.

bullets.title: Comprehensive Lift:
bullets.text: Frequently and harmoniously combined with a deep-plane facelift for a seamless transformation of the lower face and neck.

title: Buccal Fat Reduction
subtitle: Cheek Slimming
description: Refine your facial silhouette with a buccal fat pad reduction. This brief, elegant surgical procedure removes the deep fat pads in the lower cheeks, transforming a round or "chubby" face into a highly sculpted, naturally contoured V-shape profile.

bullets.title: Sculpts the Cheeks:
bullets.text: Expertly removes the buccal fat pads to reduce lower cheek fullness, revealing beautifully sculpted cheekbones.

bullets.title: Slims the Face:
bullets.text: Ideal for patients looking to completely transform a round facial appearance into a more mature, refined contour.

bullets.title: Permanent Results:
bullets.text: Because the removed fat cells do not regenerate, this procedure offers a lifetime enhancement to your facial structure.

bullets.title: Hidden Incisions:
bullets.text: The straightforward procedure is performed entirely through small incisions inside the mouth, leaving no visible scarring.

title: Ear Lobe Repair
subtitle: Restorative Surgery
description: Restore the natural, beautiful contour of your earlobes. Whether caused by heavy earrings, gauges, or accidental trauma, this meticulous surgical repair seamlessly corrects split, torn, or severely stretched earlobes, allowing you to confidently wear earrings again.

bullets.title: Restores Natural Shape:
bullets.text: Expertly repairs split or stretched tissue, flawlessly restoring the natural, rounded contour of the earlobe.

bullets.title: Quick & Painless:
bullets.text: A simple, straightforward outpatient procedure performed comfortably under local anesthesia in under an hour.

bullets.title: Virtually Invisible Scars:
bullets.text: Advanced, meticulous suturing techniques ensure that the repaired tissue heals smoothly with barely noticeable scarring.

bullets.title: Re-Piercing Possible:
bullets.text: Once fully healed, the flawlessly repaired earlobe can safely be re-pierced for your favorite earrings.

title: Neck Liposuction
subtitle: Submental Contouring
description: Permanently eliminate stubborn under-chin fullness with precision neck liposuction. This minimally invasive procedure expertly removes targeted fat deposits, dramatically revealing your jawline's natural definition and creating a sleek, highly contoured neck profile.

bullets.title: Eliminates Double Chin:
bullets.text: Permanently removes stubborn, diet-resistant fat deposits from beneath the chin and along the upper neck.

bullets.title: Sharpens Jawline:
bullets.text: Dramatically reveals and sculpts the natural bony contours of the jawline for a highly defined, elegant profile.

bullets.title: Minimally Invasive:
bullets.text: Uses extremely fine cannulas through tiny, easily hidden micro-incisions, ensuring minimal trauma and a rapid recovery.

bullets.title: Skin Retraction:
bullets.text: Advanced liposuction techniques naturally encourage the overlying skin to contract and tighten, enhancing the smooth contour.

title: Forehead Lift
subtitle: Upper Face Rejuvenation
description: A surgical forehead lift addresses deep horizontal wrinkles and significant sagging in the upper face. By lifting the skin and repositioning underlying muscles, this procedure restores a smooth, serene, and youthful appearance to the forehead.

bullets.title: Smooths Deep Lines:
bullets.text: Effectively eliminates stubborn horizontal forehead creases.

bullets.title: Long-Lasting Results:
bullets.text: Provides durable, permanent improvement compared to temporary injectables.

bullets.title: Refreshed Look:
bullets.text: Alleviates a heavy or 'angry' appearance, making you look approachable and rested.

title: Brow Lift
subtitle: Surgical Elevation
description: A surgical brow lift permanently corrects heavy, drooping eyebrows that can hood the upper eyelids. It lifts the brow arch to its ideal aesthetic position, harmonizing the upper face and opening up the eyes for a bright, awake look.

bullets.title: Permanent Elevation:
bullets.text: Surgically secures the brow at an optimal, youthful height.

bullets.title: Improves Eyelid Hooding:
bullets.text: Reduces the weight of the brow on the upper eyelids, often complementing blepharoplasty.

bullets.title: Customized Arch:
bullets.text: Tailors the shape and peak of the brow to perfectly suit your facial structure.

title: Mid-Face Lift
subtitle: Cheek Elevation
description: A surgical mid-face lift specifically targets sagging cheeks and deep nasolabial folds. By elevating the fat pads of the cheeks vertically, it restores full, youthful cheekbones and smooths the transition between the lower eyelids and the cheeks.

bullets.title: Restores Cheek Volume:
bullets.text: Lifts descended fat back to the upper cheeks for natural, youthful volume.

bullets.title: Smooths Nasolabial Folds:
bullets.text: Significantly reduces the depth of the smile lines running from the nose to mouth.

bullets.title: Natural Rejuvenation:
bullets.text: Avoids a 'pulled' look by lifting vertically rather than horizontally.

title: Orthognathic Surgery
subtitle: Corrective Jaw Surgery
description: Orthognathic surgery corrects severe jaw discrepancies and bite issues that cannot be resolved with orthodontics alone. It improves breathing, chewing function, and facial symmetry by surgically realigning the upper and lower jaws.

bullets.title: Functional Improvement:
bullets.text: Resolves difficulties with chewing, swallowing, and speech.

bullets.title: Facial Harmony:
bullets.text: Dramatically improves lower facial proportions, symmetry, and profile.

bullets.title: Airway Expansion:
bullets.text: Can effectively treat obstructive sleep apnea by opening the airway.

title: Dimple Creation
subtitle: Dimpleplasty
description: Dimpleplasty is a quick, minimally invasive surgical procedure designed to create natural-looking dimples on the cheeks or chin. The procedure involves a small incision inside the mouth, leaving no external scars, to tether the skin to the underlying muscle.

bullets.title: Enhances Smile:
bullets.text: Adds a charming, youthful characteristic to your smile.

bullets.title: No External Scars:
bullets.text: Performed entirely from within the mouth for a flawless exterior.

bullets.title: Quick Procedure:
bullets.text: Typically performed under local anesthesia in under an hour.

title: Facial Implants
subtitle: Chin, Nose, Cheek
description: Custom silicone facial implants are used to enhance the fundamental bone structure of the face. Whether building a weak chin, augmenting flat cheekbones, or refining nasal contours, implants provide permanent, striking, and balanced facial definition.

bullets.title: Permanent Volume:
bullets.text: Offers a lifelong solution to structural volume deficiencies.

bullets.title: Custom Contouring:
bullets.text: Implants are meticulously selected and shaped to fit your unique anatomy.

bullets.title: Balanced Proportions:
bullets.text: Brings harmony to facial features, such as balancing a prominent nose with a stronger chin.

title: Canthoplasty
subtitle: Eye Shape Refinement
description: Canthoplasty is a specialized surgical procedure that reshapes and tightens the outer corner of the eye (the lateral canthus). It is used to correct drooping, create a more almond-shaped or 'fox eye' appearance, and provide essential support to the lower eyelid.

bullets.title: Almond Eye Shape:
bullets.text: Elongates and slightly elevates the outer corners of the eyes.

bullets.title: Lower Lid Support:
bullets.text: Corrects lower eyelid laxity or 'ectropion', restoring functional integrity.

bullets.title: Refined Aesthetics:
bullets.text: Adds an elegant, exotic, and youthful contour to the eyes.

title: Alarplasty
subtitle: Nostril Reduction
description: Alarplasty is a delicate surgical procedure aimed specifically at narrowing wide or flared nostrils. Often performed alongside rhinoplasty or on its own, it refines the nasal base to bring the nose into perfect proportion with the rest of the face.

bullets.title: Narrows Nostrils:
bullets.text: Reduces nostril flaring and decreases the width of the nasal base.

bullets.title: Hidden Incisions:
bullets.text: Scars are concealed within the natural crease where the nostril meets the cheek.

bullets.title: Preserves Natural Look:
bullets.text: Meticulously planned to ensure the nose looks naturally proportionate, not 'pinched'.

title: Scar Revision
subtitle: Surgical Refinement
description: Surgical scar revision aims to minimize the appearance of prominent, thick, or restrictive scars. Through precise excision and meticulous re-closure using advanced plastic surgery techniques, the scar is blended closely with surrounding healthy skin.

bullets.title: Improves Appearance:
bullets.text: Transforms wide, raised, or jagged scars into thin, neat lines.

bullets.title: Restores Function:
bullets.text: Releases tight scar tissue (contractures) that may be restricting movement.

bullets.title: Advanced Closure:
bullets.text: Utilizes multi-layered suturing to minimize tension and optimize healing.

title: Wart & Tongue Tie Removal
subtitle: Minor Surgical Procedures
description: We perform minor, precise surgical procedures for the complete removal of stubborn facial warts, skin tags, and the release of tongue ties (ankyloglossia). These procedures are fast, virtually painless, and highly effective.

bullets.title: Complete Removal:
bullets.text: Surgically excises stubborn warts to prevent recurrence.

bullets.title: Improves Function:
bullets.text: Tongue tie release instantly improves speech, eating, and oral mobility.

bullets.title: Minimal Downtime:
bullets.text: Fast outpatient procedures with rapid, straightforward recovery.
